link> With just over a week until the official start of the 2025-26 NBA season, fans have been patiently awaiting where former MVP point guard Russell Westbrook will ultimately sign. On Wednesday, they finally received their answer. Speculation has been surrounding Westbrook for much of the offseason, with some linking him to EuroLeague teams interested in his services. However, Westbrook has since made it clear that his goal was to play in the NBA this coming season and that he would not be considering offers outside the NBA . One of the teams that Westbrook had been linked to all offseason was the Sacramento Kings , who are led by Domantas Sabonis, Westbrook's former teammate during their time playing together on the Oklahoma City Thunder in the early stages of Sabonis' career.
